Witness to follow: shipped kind and placement counts unchanged from origin.

Owner delegated architectural choices on 2026-11-01 (all architecture decided by the orchestrator; all progress confirmed by witness). Under that delegation the public-table kinds keep shipping, marked UNVERIFIED where 6.88g is silent. Witness required: shipped kind and placement counts from origin before and after, unchanged.

Witness counts from origin main fab8d5af (read-only, hy3d): AFTER (kinds ship): 61 kind rows, 36 distinct kind names; 3848 of 4119 placements ship; 558 placements are UNVERIFIED public-table kinds across 24 type codes; 39 types withheld with 271 placements. BEFORE (9400c259, local commit only; origin history is squashed and 9400c259 is not reachable): 37 kind rows, 3290 placements, 0 UNVERIFIED; delta +24 kind rows, +558 placements. Witness still needs a ledger dispatch from a session other than the resolver before this row closes.
